fluff.overview: Caesar's ongoing program to modernize the Legiones Marianes has extended to conventional infantry formations, with improved equipment and weapons gradually replacing older stockpiles across the Hegemony's auxiliary legions. A centuria, or century, is the Marian equivalent of a company-sized formation. Mechanized wheeled centuries use wheeled transports that offer good road speed and lower maintenance costs than tracked vehicles, well suited to the Hegemony's infrastructure-limited Periphery worlds where supply lines stretch thin. Equipped with laser rifles that offer superior range and armor penetration compared to ballistic weapons, these formations field one of the most effective personal arms available to conventional infantry, though the weapons require soldiers to carry additional power packs.
